name: @hub/root
description: Web UI control panel for the test workspace

scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @hub/server run dev & pnpm --filter @hub/client run dev
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @hub/shared run build && pnpm --filter @hub/server run build && pnpm --filter @hub/client run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @hub/shared run typecheck && pnpm --filter @hub/server run typecheck && pnpm --filter @hub/client run typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @hub/server run test && pnpm --filter @hub/client run test
scripts.test:smoke: pnpm run build && pnpm exec playwright test -c e2e/playwright.config.ts
